facts.fact: The Auditor General's information systems audit found ELOGREV implemented at only 71 out of 2,366 sites since the 2014/2015 financial year; sites are not the same as local governments, so this is a count of sites.

The ELOGREV contract with Tucksee Pty Limited does not clearly require source code transfer to government, and there is no formal access policy for the database; audit summarised 24 December 2024, undated.
ELOGREV implementation is funded by both MoFPED and URA TREP, which the audit says risks duplicated payments; budgets ignore sites covered by other revenue systems.

The audit says MoLG lacks an IT Strategic Plan, Risk Management Policy and Security Policy, and has no IT steering or strategy committees; it also recommends harmonising ELOGREV rollout with ECITIE and IRAS.

systems.country_label: Electronic Local Government Revenue Management System (E LOGREV)
systems.owner: Ministry of Local Government; vendor Tucksee Pty Limited
systems.tiers: local government sites; interfaced with URA E-Tax and NIRA NSIS, not with URSB, PBS or IFMS; 240 staff trained
treats higher and lower LGs as a single site, cutting rollout cost per site
